name: Twyfelfontein rock engravings walk
why: A guided loop among red sandstone boulders carved with thousands of animals and footprints, Namibia's first World Heritage site.
book: Entry with a compulsory guide at the visitor centre.

points.name: Twyfelfontein visitor centre
points.note: The visitor centre at the foot of the rocks.

points.name: Twyfelfontein
points.note: Engraved slabs of the Lion Plate and the dancing kudu.
